summary: 40 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • isolated-workdir: add cross-platform symlink manager for Claude session isolation (9af6258)
  • preset-tasks: add OpenSpec spec compress preset task (a68d57a)
  • preset-tasks: add agent-aware prompt variant system (bf0e05d)
  • preset-tasks: add scene background image slot to API responses (7413d81)
  • preset-tasks: add agent requirement type with family validation (4e4f25a)
  • copilot: add reasoning effort and summary configuration (43d7aa4)
  • frontend-config: add eye-protection theme variants (790ed5b)
  • frontend-config: add space-travel theme variants (540e78b)
  • frontend-config: add winter, cyberpunk, and school theme variants (b9a5aa6)
  • frontend-config: add autumn theme variants (af01174)
  • favorites: add filename validation and re-key support for name updates (8d52d74)
  • favorites: add favorites management API and service layer (0c7c96a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • branding: add PWA manifest branding support (2584ab1)
  • types: add prompt strategy types for preset tasks (31d2a10)
  • session: add target icon to preset task resolver (6c010ca)
  • research: add owner project inclusion option (7e9f3db)
  • preset-task: add agent requirement compatibility system (e18781e)
  • hero-dungeon: add scene background image slot support (679d7e4)
  • preset-task: add scene background image support (7e745dc)
  • hero, preset-task: add quick submit and status markers (d15b3ea)
  • hero: add Copilot reasoning effort configuration (4e25c49)
  • theme: add eye-protection to theme preview gallery (7627158)
  • theme: add eye-shield icon component (7cbefbb)
  • theme: register eye-protection theme in system (1ba17d9)
  • theme: add eye-protection theme background images (fd82e9b)
  • theme: add eye-protection theme CSS files (72b62f4)
  • theme: add space-travel to theme preview gallery (767f958)
  • theme: add space-rocket icon component (9b606d2)
  • theme: register space-travel theme in system (5029fa6)
  • theme: add space-travel theme background images (3768ae5)
  • theme: add space-travel theme CSS files (0934048)
  • preset-task: make favorite items clickable for improved UX (ae997bd)
  • proposal: add overwrite confirmation for loading favorites (7e241f1)
  • preset-task: add overwrite confirmation for loading favorites (617751d)
  • theme: add winter, cyberpunk and school season themes (3140511)
  • preset-task: add favorite name validation (331b8ae)
  • preset-task: add keyboard quick-submit with Ctrl/⌘+Enter (85e0f97)
  • proposal: add favorites functionality to proposal drawer (9bea8ba)
  • theme: add autumn season theme (a0b1399)
  • preset-task: add favorites functionality for preset task forms (1cc477e)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • project: improve project list interaction handling (6dc2121)
  • proposal: improve tab reconciliation stability (b16f5c7)
